title: PR 4d — statutory reports bucket by pay date; payroll journal stays on period end (owner call O1)

goals.text: Boundary behaviour is proven by the unit fixture; the prod e2e proves report/recompute consistency and the declared pay-date basis. STP (FY + YTD window, default target = latest by pay date), BAS W1/W2, year-end forms and PDF, the 941/940 deposit PDF and the deposit period accrued on processing all bucket by payDate ?? periodEnd (legacy null payDate keeps periodEnd); a fixture crossing a BAS quarter (30 Sep paid 3 Oct; 30 Jun paid 2 Jul) and a year (31 Dec paid 2 Jan) asserts each consumer's computed bucket through a where-applying DB mock; the journal entry stays dated periodEnd; re-processing a processed run is refused and its amounts never change, only its bucket; quarter/year math is UTC (1 Jan and 31 Mar/1 Apr cases pass under TZ=America/Los_Angeles).

Payroll Tax deposits / Year-end / STP tabs and the AU BAS return (when W1/W2 show) carry a footer saying statutory reports use the pay date while the P&L uses the period end; en/fr-CA/zh-CN, fr-CA U+2019.

launch.rollback: Revert the PR. No schema change. Reports go back to bucketing by periodEnd; runs already processed keep the deposit rows they accrued (a run processed while this PR was live may have accrued into the pay-date quarter; with PR 4c's payDate = periodEnd default that is the same quarter). Journal dates are unaffected either way (always periodEnd).
